steps.instruction: Add a new variant { kind: "clear" } to the Command union. Nothing else changes. Todo stays the same: its `done` field is the 'completed' flag.

steps.instruction: Add a 'clear' command that removes every todo whose `done` field is true. The types unit is adding the variant { kind: "clear" } to Command at the same time, so Command will be: {kind:"add";title;due?} | {kind:"complete";id} | {kind:"list"} | {kind:"clear"}. (1) Export a pure function `clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[]`. It returns a new array with only the todos where done === false, keeps their original order and ids, and does not change the input array. (2) parseArgs(["clear"]) returns { kind: "clear" }. (3) run(path, { kind: "clear" }) loads todos from path, applies clear, saves the result back to path, and returns a short message saying how many todos were removed, e.g. "Cleared 2 todos". Leave all existing behaviour unchanged.
steps.interfaceChange: export declare function clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[];

input.reason: Todo has no `completed` field. Its completion flag is `done`, which is the field the complete command sets, so I'm reading the request as "remove todos where done is true". I'm adding the Command variant in types, and in commands a pure clear function, parseArgs support, and run handling that saves the result.
